cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental, ineffable principle or path of the universe, beyond human comprehension and expression.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be spoken of is not the eternal Way; the name that can be named is not the eternal name;
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Nuance (English): Often used in the context of communication or discourse.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The way is speech.|My way will not be followed; it is over!|The Master said: To govern a state of a thousand chariots, be reverent in your duties and trustworthy.|Govern by virtue, regulate by ritual.
cards.Sentences: 道者，言也。|吾道不行，已矣夫！|子曰：道千乘之国，敬事而信。|道之以德，齐之以礼。
